historical_modus_operandi: Transit point for Southeast Asian tropical timber, rubber, and palm oil. Container seal swaps and re-issuance of bills of lading (switch B/L) under Singaporean holding entities.
Barge transshipment from Sumatra/Kalimantan mills lacking ISPO/RSPO certification into Malaysian export pipelines.
Financial re-invoicing and free zone re-packaging of East African and South American agricultural commodities to obscure true producer farm polygons.
